title: Network Engineer
description:
Walk\-In Drive at TCS Gandhinagar hiring for Network Engineer!
 



  





 Role: Network Engineer
 



 Skill: Networking knowledge / Telecom knowledge
 



 Experience: 1 year to 5 years
 



 Job Location: Gandhinagar
 



 Shift: 24x7 shifts
 



  





 Interview Date: 12th Sep 2026, Saturday
 



 Entry Time: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM
 



 Interview Location: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd, Garima Park, IT/ITES SEZ, DA IICT Road, Infocity, Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



  





 Things to carry for interview:
 



 • Candidates must carry a copy of their updated resume
 



 • It is mandatory to submit a valid copy of TCS application form during the drive
 



 • Please carry 2 Photocopies of original Aadhar or PAN card
 



 • Candidates must carry a passport size photo
 



  





 Education:
 



 • Minimum 15 years of regular, full\-time education (10 \+ 2 \+ 3\)
 



 • Full\-time graduation with CCNA Certified
 



 • Must have completed 15 years of regular education
 



  





 Must Have Skills:
 



 • Good Communication and interpersonal skills
 



 • Experience in last mile access network and network elements routers
 



 • Good understanding of telecom processes
 



 • Basic understanding of telecom technologies such FTTB FTTN VDSL Copper
 



 GPON etc.
 



 • Exposure of working on Provisioning configuration of Telecom services
 



 • Readiness to work in shifts
 



 • Experience in the design, configuration and telecom systems, hardware and
 



 software applications.
 



 • Understanding of switching systems, cabling and fiber optics.
 



 • Knowledge of network topology
 



 • Cisco Platforms 78xx, 65xx, firewalls, routers, switches would be added
 



 advantage
 



 • LAN, WAN, WLAN infrastructures
 



 • Protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, SMTP, NTP, SNMP, VoIP
 



 • ATM, MPLS, Frame Relay, and Metro Ethernet
 



  





 Good To Have Skills:
 



 • Perform configuration, turn\-up and testing of managed services equipment
 



 for day 1 (Service Delivery) customer installations and day 2 (Service
 



 Assurance) support of existing customers.
 



 • Work with off\-net providers to troubleshoot connectivity issues with
 



 circuits or vendor supplied Customer Premises Equipment (CPE).
 



 • Use various software systems and applications to effectively troubleshoot
 



 issues and equipment relating to underlying network connectivity, as well
 



 as to identify configuration and other related issues with managed services
 



 equipment.
 



 • Train and mentor supported teams.
 



 • Collaborate with and foster relationships with internal and external
 



 customers
 



  





 Process Specific Responsibilities:
 



 Networking knowledge / Telecom knowledge with CCNA certified. Basic understanding of telecom technologies such FTTB, FTTN, VDSL Copper
 



 GPON.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Handle customer enquiries through Voice, Email, and Chat channels
 



 • Resolve customer issues accurately and efficiently within defined timelines
 



 • Deliver high levels of customer satisfaction and First Contact Resolution (FCR)
 



 • Manage customer complaints and escalations with complete ownership
 



 • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in internal systems
 



 • Meet quality, productivity, compliance, and customer experience targets
 



 • Work directly with customers while adhering to project timelines and SLAs
 



 • Follow Agile ways of working and support continuous improvement initiatives
 



 • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure prompt issue resolution
 



 • Ensure adherence to organizational policies and customer service standards
 



  





 Education:
 



 • Bachelor's Degree with CCNA Certification
 



 • Minimum 15 years of regular education
 



  





 Technical Skills:
 



 • Cisco Platforms 78xx, 65xx, firewalls, routers, switches would be added
 



 advantage
 



 • LAN, WAN, WLAN infrastructures
 



 • Protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, SMTP, NTP, SNMP, VoIP
 



 • ATM, MPLS, Frame Relay, and Metro Ethernet
 



 • Understanding of switching systems, cabling and fiber optics
 



 • Basic understanding of telecom technologies such FTTB FTTN VDSL Copper
 



 GPON etc.
 



  





 Soft Skills:
 



 • Use various software systems and applications to effectively troubleshoot
 



 issues and equipment relating to underlying network connectivity, as well
 



 as to identify configuration and other related issues with managed services
 



 equipment.
 



 • Collaborate with and foster relationships with internal and external
 



 customers.
 



 • Perform configuration, turn\-up and testing of managed services equipment
 



 for day 1 (Service Delivery) customer installations and day 2 (Service
 



 Assurance) support of existing customers.
 



  





 Preferred Qualifications:
 



 • 1\-5 years of experience in Networking or Telecom
 



 • CCNA Certified
 



 • Prior experience in Network and Telecom Domain
 



 • Exposure to customer satisfaction and quality metrics
